conventions.convention: Conservative states are U=(ρ,m,E), with ρ>0 and ε=E−|m|²/(2ρ)>0. R>0, γ>1, c_v=R/(γ−1), μ>0, ζ≥0, and κ>0; mathematical entropy is η=−ρs.
The stress is τ=2μD⁰+ζ(tr D)I, with D⁰=sym ∇u−(div u/d)I. In dimension one the deviatoric part vanishes; bulk viscosity may be zero.
Entropy variables use β=1/T, v_m=βu, and v_E=−β; the directional entropy potential is ψ_j=ρRu_j.
The periodic SBP node set is finite and nonempty; H is strictly positive diagonal, HD_j+D_jᵀH=0, and D_j1=0. Differentiation acts on entire nodal arrays componentwise.

The finite-volume branch contains only viscous diffusion on uniform interval cells. Shared fluxes point rightward, use arithmetic conservative-state face means, and enter as (G_right−G_left)/h; both endpoint fluxes are zero.

The guarded Euler loop tests each candidate against a specified compact set C⊂G. A rejected candidate returns the preceding accepted state and its accepted-step count; budget N=0 returns the input immediately.
The time-error estimate fixes the spatial grid, assumes exact initialization and an exact trajectory entirely inside int C, and imposes NΔt≤T. Its constant need not be uniform in the grid.

load_bearing.statement: The mathematical entropy η=−ρs has positive-definite Hessian on G. Its entropy variables are v=(c_vγ−s−β|u|²/2, βu, −β), with β=c_vρ/ε=1/T. The Euler entropy flux is compatible with F_j, and ψ_j=vᵀF_j−q_j=ρRu_j. The entropy-variable map is locally diffeomorphic and η is strictly convex on G.

The displayed bilinear form factors as B_U(Z,W)=(R_UZ)·(R_UW)=Σ_jk Z_jᵀK_jk(U)W_k, so K=R_U*R_U is symmetric positive semidefinite. For Z_k=∂_kv, F_j^visc=Σ_kK_jk∂_kv, and the quadratic production equals τ:∇u/T+κ|∇T|²/T²≥0.
The defined two-point flux is well-defined on G×G, symmetric, consistent, locally Lipschitz, and satisfies (v(U_R)−v(U_L))ᵀF_j^ec(U_L,U_R)=ψ_j(U_R)−ψ_j(U_L).
The set G is open and convex in R^(d+2). In particular, the arithmetic mean of any two admissible conservative states is admissible.
Every smooth G-valued solution of the unforced model satisfies ∂_tη+Σ_j∂_j(ηu_j+κ∂_jT/T)=−Σ_jk(∂_jv)ᵀK_jk(∂_kv)=−(τ:∇u/T+κ|∇T|²/T²)≤0.

concerns.concern: Verification step 2.1 says “Formula [F2] gives” v_E=(−1,−1/2,−1) and v_m=(0,0,0), but F2 states symmetry and the entropy-potential jump identity, not the entropy-variable formula. The computation is correct using lem-compressible-ideal-gas-entropy-pair-and-variables; the local fact reference should identify that formula.
